notes: Created 4-phase implementation plan addressing follow-up issues from undo/redo expansion pre-commit review (2026-07-21). Phase 1 (P0): Genericize error toast messages from technical JS internals to user-friendly 'Something went wrong'. Phase 2 (P1): Extract 8 inline Vue expressions from segmented controls into 5 dedicated handler methods (setTitleAlignment, toggleTitleShowBackground, setBackgroundStyle, removeBackgroundImageAtomic, removeOverlayAtomic) across 3 handler modules. Phase 3 (P1): Add 9 E2E Playwright tests in new file test/e2e/undo-redo.spec.js covering all major undoable action categories. Phase 4 (P2): Document Cmd+Z textarea verification (no code change needed - KeyboardHandler already suppresses shortcuts in editable elements). Consulted @world-review for UX priority analysis and @planner for technical approach design. N-1 uses handler module methods (Option A) to keep undo lifecycle self-contained. N-2 keeps console.error with full debug details while genericizing user-facing toasts.
